links.outcome: Readability of chatbot fluoride answers (FRES, FKRGL) for parents and caregivers
links.effect: FRES median 68.5 with no significant difference between chatbots (p = 0.12); FKRGL differences borderline (p = 0.041) but not retained after correction; ChatGPT described as more readable.
links.quote: While FRES (median = 68.5, p = 0.12) and Similarity Index (≤ 10%, p = 0.54) showed no significant differences, ChatGPT consistently produced more readable and original content.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates and compares the performance (quality, readability, reliability) of three off-the-shelf LLMs on answering pediatric fluoride questions based on AAPD guidelines, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice.
